faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Are certificates recognized by the government?
faq.a1: Yes. All certificates issued through our network are government-recognized and valid for employment and higher education.
faq.a2: Course durations range from 1 month (short skill courses) to 12 months (diploma programs). Each course page shows exact duration.
faq.a3: Fees vary by course and center. Course pages show the starting fee range. Contact your nearest center for exact fee structure.
faq.q4: Can I take classes in Hindi?
faq.a4: Yes. Most of our centers offer instruction in both Hindi and English. Center profiles indicate the available languages.
faq.q5: How do I verify my certificate?
faq.a5: Visit the Verify section, enter your certificate number, and the system will confirm authenticity in real time.
faq.a6: Yes. Our Student Corner provides job board access, resume templates, and placement support through our partner employers.
